data.cultural_impact: The name Sukanta holds a significant place in the Hindu cultural context as it evokes feelings of positivity, happiness, and warmth. The name is believed to bring luck and prosperity to the individual bearing it. It is common for parents in the Hindu community to bestow this name on their child, hoping that they will grow up to be good, kind, and bring happiness and joy to those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Sukanta holds deep significance as it reflects the innate desire for happiness and joy that exists within each soul. The name is a reminder that we are all inherently good and kind, and that our actions and words should reflect this inner quality. It is a call to cultivate positive virtues such as kindness, compassion, and joy, not just for ourselves but for others as well. The name Sukanta serves as a constant reminder to stay connected to the divine source of all happiness and joy, and to share this divine gift with others.

historical_references.reference: Sukanta was a famous saint-poet in medieval Bengal, India. He lived during the 12th and 13th centuries and is known for his devotional poems to the Hindu goddess Kali.

Another reference mentions Sukanta as a renowned scholar and poet in ancient India, who was prominent during the Gupta Empire (4th to 6th centuries CE) and is known for his works on grammar, rhetoric, and poetics.
historical_references.context: Ancient India, Gupta Empire, Scholarship and Poetry
